patterns.hero: Asymmetric bento grid or wide split layout for landing page. Use big Syne headings.
patterns.dashboard: Fixed left sidebar on desktop (width 64), bottom tab bar or hamburger menu on mobile. Main content has left margin on desktop to accommodate sidebar.
patterns.challenge_grid: 3-column responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-8. Cards stretch to full height.
patterns.portfolio: Bento grid (Tetris grid) style. Mix 2x2, 2x1, 1x2 spanning elements to create tension and visual interest.

motion.hover: Subtle transform translate-y-[-4px] on cards. Button background transitions 0.2s ease.
motion.page_transition: Simple opacity fade for page mounts.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all scale/translate animations.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-challenge-button', data-testid='login-form').

images.description: Diverse group of students gathered around laptop

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts Syne and Inter in the primary HTML template.
Implement light and dark mode toggling using Tailwind 'dark' class applied to HTML root.
Do NOT use heavy box-shadows for cards; strictly adhere to the defined 1px borders.
All headers MUST use the Syne font-family (700-800 weight with tight tracking); body must use Inter.
For marketing pages (landing), utilize pure HTML/Tailwind for maximum layout flexibility (bento grids, overlaps).
For dashboards and forms, heavily customize Shadcn components to match these specs (strip Vercel-look, adjust radii and borders).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure hover states use the designated hover colors and maintain WCAG contrast.
